rules.name: Toda Proposition 5.1 n=3 Delta injectivity
rules.description: For the concrete Delta map from pi_5^5 to pi_3^2, the Proposition 5.1 data Delta(iota_5)=plus or minus 2 eta_2 gives the injectivity required in the n=3 proof of Toda Proposition 5.3.

rules.name: Toda Proposition 5.3 n=3 Delta injectivity implies Hopf zero
rules.description: In the concrete exact sequence pi_5^3 -> pi_5^5 -> pi_3^2, injectivity of Delta makes Ker(Delta) zero. Exactness therefore makes the image of H zero.

rules.name: Toda Proposition 5.3 n=3 Hopf zero implies suspension surjective
rules.description: In the concrete exact sequence pi_4^2 -> pi_5^3 -> pi_5^5, if H is zero then Ker(H) is all of pi_5^3. Exactness therefore makes suspension E surjective.

rules.name: Toda Proposition 5.3 n=3 Hopf eta_5 surjectivity
rules.description: Phase 58 gives H(nu-prime)=eta_5. Proposition 5.1 gives the order-two higher eta family, whose n=5 instance is pi_6^5=Z/2{eta_5}. Therefore H from pi_6^3 to pi_6^5 is surjective.

rules.name: Toda Proposition 5.3 n=3 Hopf surjective implies Delta zero
rules.description: In the concrete exact sequence pi_6^3 -> pi_6^5 -> pi_4^2, surjectivity of H makes Im(H) all of pi_6^5. Exactness gives Ker(Delta)=pi_6^5, so Delta is zero.

rules.name: Toda Proposition 5.3 n=3 Delta zero implies suspension injective
rules.description: In the concrete exact sequence pi_6^5 -> pi_4^2 -> pi_5^3, Delta zero makes Im(Delta) zero. Exactness therefore makes the kernel of suspension E zero, so E is injective.

rules.name: Toda Proposition 5.3 n=3 suspension isomorphism
rules.description: If the concrete suspension map from pi_4^2 to pi_5^3 is both injective and surjective, it is an isomorphism.
